title: fix: show connection guidance only for connection failures
body:
## What Problem This Solves

A failed Talk catalog lookup tells already-connected users to connect to the Gateway. The Gateway settings page also shows retry guidance during a healthy connection.

## User Impact

Talk shows the actual lookup failure while preserving connection guidance for disconnected clients. The Gateway retry hint appears only for a failed disconnected attempt.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Talk error boundary now retains its error instead of presenting every failure as disconnection. The catalog handler returns the existing readable message for an ambiguous Talk agent, without logging-only exception names and codes. No agent selection or authentication behavior changes.

## Evidence

Maintainer validation: the Talk catalog, Talk settings and Connection page test files passed on the published source (two runner shards; 65 tests in the UI shard). The before/after screenshots were inspected. No production edits were needed; no new live-Gateway or screenshot run is claimed.

- Real isolated Gateway, Safari on Tempbook: reproduced the connected Talk failure and the unnecessary healthy-connection hint, then checked the fixes.
- 65 focused Talk/Gateway UI tests passed, along with the existing locale check and catalog handler coverage.
- The strengthened UI regressions fail on the base behavior. The catalog regression also fails with the base handler and passes with the fix.
- Formatting, focused lint, i18n verification, UI typecheck and runtime/UI builds passed. Existing bundle-budget warnings remain; no limits were changed.
- Independent P0–P2 reviews found no actionable findings. Net test growth is four lines in existing suites.
